reopen_from.reopen_reason: The prior PRE unit ended before any training action because prose-only planning and unbounded diagnostics were not separated from scientific non-adherence. R3 changes only the arm-invariant action-turn protocol.

frozen_scientific_substrate.boundary: immediately after the first independently verified successful persisted model parameter update

provider.incomplete_response_policy: GET/poll an existing response only; never duplicate a paid generation POST implicitly

action_turn_contract.rule_text_only: A pre-boundary prose-only response is not an action. At most one deterministic protocol notice is returned, after which a second prose-only response fails closed.
action_turn_contract.rule_diagnostic_budget: After two executed pre-boundary diagnostic actions, further diagnostic actions are not executed and a deterministic notice states that the next valid pre-boundary action is run_training.
action_turn_contract.rule_training_choice: The protocol never specifies SFT versus RL. The agent must choose the training method and bounded config according to the task and binding strategy instruction.

pre_only_decision_rule.clean_headroom: ADHERED_UNCALIBRATED => PRE passes; append a new POST_STRATEGY-only authorization under the same action-turn contract.
pre_only_decision_rule.interpretable_nonclean: Any interpretable non-clean PRE status => close V19R-003 because post-lock-in failure would be uninterpretable without pre-lock-in enactment headroom.
pre_only_decision_rule.no_evidence: NO_EVIDENCE after this action-turn repair => close the current candidate as support-nonexecutable on this fixed substrate; do not buy another PRE retry.
